name: omnilab/kegg
description: Omnilab KEGG: a compound (C07481), a drug (D00528), a reaction (R00200), a pathway map (map00010, hsa00010) or an enzyme (2.7.1.40) by its KEGG identifier - names, formula and masses, a reaction's equation, a pathway's class and description, an enzyme's class and systematic name - the same thing in CAS, ChEBI, ChEMBL and Rhea as identifiers, its reactions, pathways, enzymes, compounds and GO terms as related things; a compound by its ChEBI id; a search; through KEGG's REST API (rest.kegg.jp), for academic use by academic users only.
